topic: 箱装食品码垛工作站 宣传片脚本（客户稿）

shots.title: 包装线末端场景
shots.download_query: food packaging line end multiple orange palletizing robots working conveyor and pallet positions visible
shots.visual_query: End of a food packaging line with several orange palletizing robots operating, conveyors moving boxes, pallet stations visible in the frame
shots.voice_text: 食品包装线的末端，一箱箱成品下线以后，最重复、最累人的一道活，就是码垛。
shots.voice_requirements: 全片男声配音，语速稍快

content_blocks.purpose: 定义视频基本参数：时长、画面方向、配音要求、修改限制
content_blocks.content: 做一条 80 秒左右的横屏宣传片，讲箱装食品是怎么码上托盘的。全片男声配音，语速稍快，下面每段引号里的话就是配音原文，一个字不要改。不要出现任何客户和设备厂商的名字。

extra_requirements: 不要出现任何客户和设备厂商的名字

shots.title: 来料输送过程
shots.download_query: bottled water cartons on conveyor belt排队 moving toward robot pickup point
shots.visual_query: Cartons of bottled water and milk boxes lined up on a conveyor belt, moving forward one by one to the robot's grabbing position
shots.voice_text: 整箱的瓶装水、纸箱装的牛奶，装好箱以后先在输送带上排好队，一箱一箱送到机器人的抓取位。

content_blocks.purpose: 展示整箱产品在输送带上的流动过程
content_blocks.content: 接着看来料。整箱的瓶装水在输送带上排着队往前走，一箱一箱送到机器人能抓的位置。

shots.title: 机械臂抓取动作
shots.download_query: red robotic arm picking up milk carton from conveyor lifting and turning
shots.visual_query: Close-up of a red robotic arm gripping a full carton from the conveyor, lifting it up, rotating, and moving toward the pallet area
shots.voice_text: 机器人从输送带上抓起整箱，抬起、转身，送到托盘上方。抓得稳、转得快，节拍才跟得上产线。

content_blocks.purpose: 聚焦机械臂抓取与转身动作，强调速度与稳定性
content_blocks.content: 然后是抓取。红色机械臂从输送带上抓起一箱牛奶，抬起来、转过身，送到托盘上方。这一段用特写，让人看清楚抓起和转身的动作。

shots.title: 箱子精准落位
shots.download_query: robot placing box on red pallet already layered with stacked cartons
shots.visual_query: Robotic arm placing a carton precisely onto a red pallet that already has multiple layers of boxes stacked neatly
shots.voice_text: 落到托盘上，每一箱的位置和朝向，都按设定好的垛型来，一层码满，再码下一层。
shots.subtitle: 一层码满，再码下一层

content_blocks.purpose: 展示箱子准确放置于托盘，体现程序控制
content_blocks.content: 再看落位。机械臂把纸箱放到红色托盘上，托盘上已经码好了好几层。

content_blocks.purpose: 作为屏幕上显示的文字内容
content_blocks.content: 一层码满，再码下一层

shots.title: 整齐码垛成果
shots.download_query: neatly stacked cartons on pallet robotic arm continuing to add more layers
shots.visual_query: Multiple layers of cartons neatly stacked on a pallet, robotic arm still in motion adding another layer on top
shots.voice_text: 箱子码得整齐，整垛才稳。后面叉车转运、进库存放，都不容易倒箱、塌垛。

content_blocks.purpose: 表现码垛整齐带来的稳定性优势
content_blocks.content: 码齐以后看整垛：托盘上好几层整箱整整齐齐，机械臂还在继续往上码。

shots.title: 适应多种箱型
shots.download_query: multiple parallel conveyors in bottled water plant robotic arm shuttling between lines
shots.visual_query: Several parallel conveyors in a bottled water facility, robotic arm moving back and forth between them handling different box types
shots.voice_text: 同一个工作站，箱型变了，改的主要是垛型程序，必要时再换抓具，不用动整条线。

content_blocks.purpose: 说明系统灵活性，适应不同箱型
content_blocks.content: 讲一下换箱型。瓶装水车间里好几条输送带并排，机械臂在输送带和托盘之间来回搬整箱。

shots.title: 人机协同作业
shots.download_query: worker walking beside palletizing station robotic arm continuously stacking boxes behind
shots.visual_query: A worker walking along the side of a palletizing station, checking operations while a robotic arm stacks boxes continuously in the background
shots.voice_text: 现场留一个人巡线、换托盘就够了，搬箱子这种重复的体力活，交给机器人。

content_blocks.purpose: 突出人工只需巡检，重复工由机器人承担
content_blocks.content: 人和机器的分工：工人在码垛工位旁边巡视，身后机器人一直在码箱子。

shots.title: 选型准备事项
shots.download_query: robotic arm palletizing bottled water cartons same scene as before
shots.visual_query: Robotic arm continues to stack bottled water cartons on a pallet, same setting as previous shots
shots.voice_text: 想上一套码垛工作站，先把这四样准备好：箱子的尺寸和重量、每小时要码多少箱、托盘规格，还有目标垛型。

content_blocks.purpose: 列出客户需提供的技术参数
content_blocks.content: 然后讲选型要准备什么，画面还是机械臂码瓶装水。

shots.title: 收尾与行动号召
shots.download_query: full red pallet standing beside workstation robotic arm beginning next cycle
shots.visual_query: A fully loaded red pallet stationed beside the workstation, robotic arm starting the next palletizing cycle
shots.voice_text: 把你的箱型和垛型发过来，我们照着现场条件，帮你把这一段码垛工位排出来。

content_blocks.purpose: 引导客户提供信息以便定制方案
content_blocks.content: 最后收尾，码满的红色托盘停在工位旁，机器人开始下一轮。
